detail.context: an array of length 2 containing the row number and column number of the upper-left corner of a submatrix of board which matches pattern. If there is more than one such submatrix, return the coordinates of the submatrix with the lowest row index, and in case there is still a tie, return the coordinates of the submatrix with the lowest column index. If there are no suitable answers, return [-1, -1].
a-bcd- e-a--- bcd-e- The character '-' signifies an empty space on the screen. Input: sentence = ["i","had","apple","pie"], rows = 4, cols = 5

examples.title: Find Sorted Submatrices With Maximum Element At Most K

detail.context: Return the number of submatrices of grid that satisfy the following conditions: The maximum element in the submatrix less than or equal to k. Each row in the submatrix is sorted in non-increasing order. A submatrix (x1, y1, x2, y2) is a matrix that forms by choosing all cells grid[x][y] where x1 <= x <= x2 and y1 <= y <= y2. Input: grid = [[4,3,2,1],[8,7,6,1]], k = 3
